description: Change of use of no's 28, 30 & 32 from Student Accommodation (Sui Generis) to a Pre-School/Preparatory School (no's 30 & 32) (maximum capacity of 250 pupils) and a Sixth Form College (no. 28) (maximum 100 pupils) (all Use Class D1) and associated internal works to the buildings. External works to the buildings comprise erection of 4 storey wall to the rear of and between no's 28 & 30 and rear basement infill extension to no. 32. Replacement and relocation of existing rear staircases and provision of soft play area with freestanding awning over to the rear with installation of ducting below to all 3 buildings. Removal of a selection of non-original windows in rear elevation. Installation of platform lift between no's. 28 & 30 and installation of railings to front light wells and street boundary railings and balustrades. Replacement of front doors to each building. Replacement of existing doors with a window at the rear of no. 28 and an adjustment to the size of an existing window at the rear side return of No.30***WITHDRAWN***
